title: eat shit & die 239
author: bpatrick
body:
I’ve been super busy but I’m trying to make comics and I still need to return some emails and mail some stuff. I’m not saying I’m not an asshole for not having done it already, I’m just saying I’m not a total asshole and I’m trying.

Edit: I think it’s the colors that ruin this one. Which sucks because I was excited about it. I tried to color it while visiting relatives and it just didn’t work out.

comments.author: Phil C.
comments.text:
Always happy to see new work from you. This is another great one.

Keep writing and drawing!

comments.text: Are you kidding? This kicks ass. Wish I could see your internal version of it. 🙂
